def: The visually identifiable architectural style of the house exterior (e.g., modern, traditional, colonial, contemporary) as inferred from form, roofline, and façade composition.
rat: Buyers often associate certain architectural styles with prestige, desirability, or timelessness, directly influencing willingness-to-pay.

def: The degree to which exterior design elements (materials, colors, shapes) appear harmoniously integrated and stylistically consistent.
rat: A cohesive design signals quality and intentionality, enhancing perceived value.

def: The visual balance and proportion between structural elements such as windows, doors, roof, and walls.
rat: Balanced proportions create aesthetic harmony and visual comfort, increasing perceived attractiveness.

def: The richness and refinement of visible architectural details such as trims, moldings, and façade ornamentation.
rat: Fine detailing conveys craftsmanship and higher construction quality, raising perceived value.

def: The apparent physical state of the exterior surfaces, including paint, siding, roofing, and visible structural integrity.
rat: Visible wear or deterioration reduces perceived quality and increases expected maintenance costs, lowering WTP.

def: The visible state of interior finishes, walls, floors, and ceilings, indicating upkeep and maintenance level.
rat: Well-maintained interiors suggest lower future repair costs and better care, increasing perceived value.

def: The visible state of fixed kitchen elements such as cabinetry, countertops, and built-in appliances.
rat: A well-maintained kitchen signals readiness for use and reduces renovation needs, enhancing WTP.

def: The visible state of bathroom fixtures, tiles, and surfaces.
rat: Bathrooms in good condition imply hygiene and lower renovation costs, strongly affecting perceived value.

def: The apparent quality and refinement of interior materials such as flooring, wall finishes, and built-in surfaces.
rat: High-quality materials convey durability and luxury, increasing perceived value.

def: The visible quality of kitchen materials including countertops, cabinetry, and backsplash.
rat: Premium materials in kitchens are strong value drivers due to their functional and aesthetic importance.

def: The visible quality of bathroom materials such as tiles, fixtures, and surfaces.
rat: High-end bathroom finishes signal comfort and luxury, enhancing WTP.

def: The visible quality and durability of exterior materials such as cladding, roofing, and masonry.
rat: Durable, premium exterior materials suggest longevity and lower maintenance, increasing perceived value.

def: The perceived openness and volume of interior spaces as inferred from room proportions and visual depth.
rat: Spacious interiors evoke comfort and flexibility, increasing perceived livability and WTP.

def: The perceived openness and working space within the kitchen area.
rat: A spacious kitchen enhances usability and social appeal, raising perceived value.

def: The perceived openness and comfort of the bathroom area.
rat: Spacious bathrooms convey luxury and comfort, increasing desirability.

def: The perceived openness of the outdoor environment, including yard size and unobstructed views.
rat: Open outdoor spaces enhance privacy and recreational potential, increasing WTP.

def: The visual sense of logical and comfortable spatial connection between rooms.
rat: Good flow enhances usability and comfort, improving perceived livability.

def: The apparent amount of daylight entering interior spaces through windows or openings.
rat: Bright interiors feel more pleasant and healthy, increasing perceived quality of life and WTP.

def: The visible level of daylight in the kitchen area.
rat: Well-lit kitchens appear more functional and inviting, enhancing perceived value.

def: The visible level of daylight in the bathroom area.
rat: Natural light in bathrooms enhances comfort and hygiene perception, increasing desirability.

def: The quality and distribution of exterior lighting as visible in photos (daylight or artificial).
rat: Good exterior lighting enhances safety and aesthetic appeal, improving perceived value.

def: The degree to which interior color schemes appear balanced, coordinated, and visually pleasing.
rat: Harmonious colors create emotional comfort and aesthetic appeal, increasing WTP.

def: The visual coherence of exterior color combinations across façade elements.
rat: Balanced exterior colors enhance curb appeal and perceived design quality.

def: The visible absence of dirt, clutter, or disorganization in interior spaces.
rat: Clean interiors suggest good maintenance and care, increasing perceived property quality.

def: The visible cleanliness of exterior surfaces, windows, and surrounding areas.
rat: Clean exteriors enhance curb appeal and signal good upkeep, raising WTP.

def: The visual attractiveness of the view from or around the property, including landscape, greenery, or skyline.
rat: Pleasant views enhance emotional satisfaction and exclusivity, increasing WTP.

def: The perceived level of visual privacy from neighboring properties or public spaces.
rat: Greater privacy increases comfort and exclusivity, raising perceived value.

def: The visible aesthetic quality of the immediate neighborhood environment as seen from exterior photos.
rat: Attractive surroundings enhance perceived safety and prestige, increasing WTP.

def: The apparent modernity and design currency of fixed kitchen fixtures and built-in appliances.
rat: Modern fixtures signal recent updates and functional convenience, increasing perceived value.

def: The apparent modernity and design currency of bathroom fixtures and fittings.
rat: Modern bathrooms convey comfort and reduced renovation needs, enhancing WTP.

def: The visible quality and design of permanent lighting fixtures throughout the property.
rat: High-quality fixtures enhance ambiance and perceived construction quality.

def: The visible design quality and organization of landscaping elements such as lawns, plants, and pathways.
rat: Well-designed landscaping enhances curb appeal and perceived care, increasing WTP.

def: The visible presence and quality of fixed outdoor amenities such as patios, decks, or pools.
rat: Outdoor amenities expand usable space and lifestyle appeal, raising perceived value.

def: The visible upkeep of outdoor areas including lawns, fences, and driveways.
rat: Well-maintained outdoor spaces signal care and reduce perceived future effort, increasing WTP.

def: The quality and balance of lighting in listing photos, affecting visibility and mood.
rat: Good lighting enhances perceived spaciousness and attractiveness, influencing buyer impressions.

def: The framing, angle, and composition of listing photos that affect how spaces are perceived.
rat: Well-composed photos make spaces appear larger and more appealing, increasing perceived value.

def: The degree to which key property features are obscured or hidden in photos.
rat: Clear visibility of features builds trust and transparency, positively affecting WTP.

def: The fidelity of color representation in photos relative to natural appearance.
rat: Accurate colors improve realism and trust, supporting positive valuation.
